Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sonali - 35 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vinod - 40 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The classroom - a blackboard, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Vinod stand near him.]

Aarav: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav trips on the step and scrapes his knee; it bleeds.]

Vinod: "Hey, look at that!"

[A shard of glass cuts Aarav's foot and blood flows.]

Sonali (excited): "Yes, all right."

[Aarav bumps his head on the door frame and his forehead bleeds.]

Vinod (laughing): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The classroom - Day

[Aarav stands in the classroom. Sonali and Vinod stand near him.]

Vinod: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav raises his hand to answer.]

Sonali: "One more time!"

[Aarav writes on the blackboard.]

Vinod: "One more time!"

[Aarav reads his book at his desk.]

Aarav: "I'm ready!"

[Aarav yawns in the class.]

Aarav: "I really enjoyed today."
